# Crown

> Crown is the first AI-powered Amazon growth agency in the UAE. Based in Dubai, Crown launches and scales brands on Amazon.ae and Amazon.sa with AI-driven PPC management, listing optimisation, and full account management.

## About

Crown is a Dubai-based Amazon growth agency that helps UAE brands, KSA brands, and global brands launch and scale on Amazon.ae and Amazon.sa. Crown uses a proprietary AI agent that monitors Amazon accounts and PPC campaigns 24/7, catching wasted ad spend, optimising bids, and generating data-backed recommendations from the client's own account data. Every recommendation is approved by the client before any change is made.

## Services

Crown runs the full Amazon operation across three phases:

### Phase 1: Product Research and Financial Feasibility
- Product hunting and niche analysis
- Demand and competition analysis
- Financial feasibility report with full cost modelling
- Supplier research and coordination

### Phase 2: Amazon Launch
- Seller Central account and Brand Registry setup
- Listing creation in English and Arabic
- A+ content and photography brief
- FBA shipment and inbound setup
- Launch pricing strategy
- Launch PPC campaign architecture

### Phase 3: Ongoing Growth and Account Management
- Full PPC management (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display)
- Wasted spend detection and elimination
- Bid and ACOS optimisation
- Budget pacing
- Keyword ranking and campaign promotion
- TACOS trend tracking
- Listing optimisation
- Review strategy
- Inventory monitoring
- Monthly performance reporting

## Who We Help

- UAE brands ready to sell on Amazon.ae
- KSA brands launching on Amazon.sa
- Global brands entering the Middle East via Amazon
- Brands already on Amazon but not growing

## Crown AI Agent

Crown's AI agent monitors Amazon accounts 24/7. It scans every campaign, search term, bid, and budget line. It catches wasted spend the moment it starts, flags budget issues before they cost money, and generates clear data-backed recommendations every day. No human can watch an Amazon account around the clock. Crown does. Every recommendation is sourced from the client's own account data, not generic benchmarks.
